adminModeration.title: Abuse filter
adminModeration.body: Publish-boundary checks for this workspace. Both are off by default; they only ever reject a publish (content is never edited).
adminModeration.shrinkHint: Reject a publish whose new text is smaller than this fraction of the published text (0–1, e.g. 0.2 = under 20%). Leave blank to turn off.
adminModeration.wordsHint: One per line. A publish is rejected only when a listed word is newly added. Leave blank to turn off.

spaceModeration.abuseBody: Add to this workspace's abuse filter for this space only. Your rules can be stricter than the workspace floor, never weaker: banned words are added to it, and a shrink ratio must be at least the workspace's.
spaceModeration.tenantFloor: Workspace floor: mass-delete {{ratio}}, {{count}} banned word(s). This space can only add to it.
spaceModeration.shrinkHint: Reject a publish whose new text is smaller than this fraction (0–1). Leave blank to inherit the workspace value; a lower value than the workspace's has no effect (the stricter one wins).
spaceModeration.wordsHint: One per line, added to the workspace list. A publish is rejected only when a listed word is newly added. Leave blank to add none.
spaceModeration.effective: In effect here: mass-delete {{ratio}}, {{count}} banned word(s) total.

adminAuth.body: How people sign in to this workspace, and who becomes a member when they do.

adminAuth.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Test the connection first.

To let one person comment, assign a custom role that includes comment, or grant comment on a single page from that page’s permissions. The two are independent: turning the toggles off does not remove a comment grant.

history.revertRunConfirm: Revert {{author}}'s latest {{count}} revisions in one step? The page is restored to just before their edits; their revisions stay in history, and checkbox states follow the current live values.
history.revertRunNoBaseline: All visible revisions are by {{author}}, so there is no earlier revision to revert to. Review the diffs and restore a version manually.

attachments.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{filename}}"? The file cannot be recovered.

delete.backlinkWarning_one: One other page links here. That link will stop working.
delete.backlinkWarning_other: {{count}} other pages link here. Those links will stop working.

members.groupRolesMark_one: Holds one role through a group. Hover to see which.
members.groupRolesMark_other: Holds {{count}} roles through groups. Hover to see which.
members.title: Members
members.notEmailed: Not emailed. Copy the link above and hand it over yourself.
members.eraseAnalyticsConfirm: Erase the reading history of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this workspace? Their access, API keys and sessions end immediately.
members.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invite for {{email}}? The sent link stops working.
members.seatLimit: Seat limit reached. Upgrade to invite more members.
members.inviteAlreadyMember: That address already belongs to a member. Inviting them again would create a second account.
members.passwordSetupUnavailable: A password entrance cannot be added for this member.

status.idp: Signs in through the identity provider
status.local: Local user, signs in with a password

members.lastDirectAdmin: A group holds admin, but group-granted admins can be lost by an IdP-side change. At least one directly granted admin must remain.
members.lockoutRefused: That would leave nobody who can sign in and administer this workspace. Give another administrator a way in first.
members.confirmRequired: That would leave a single way in, and this screen cannot check that it works. Set up another one under sign-in methods, then try again.
members.exemptFloorConfirmRequired: That would leave this workspace with no exempt administrator who can sign in if the identity provider goes down. Exempt another administrator, or turn off the SSO requirement, first.
members.suspendedRoleChange: This member is suspended. Bring them back before changing their role.
members.removePasswordConfirm: Remove the password entrance for {{name}}? Their sessions end with it, and they sign in through the identity provider from now on.
members.removePasswordLastWayIn: This is the only way this member can sign in. Suspend them instead.
members.removePasswordSsoFloor: SSO is required here, and this is the last exempt member who holds a password. Name another before removing this one.
members.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? They cannot sign in, their grants and API keys are revoked, and their sessions end. The seat stays theirs and nothing is deleted.
members.reactivateConfirm: Bring {{name}} back? Roles they had through a group do NOT return. The identity provider re-adds those on their next sign-in, and a member without one keeps none of them.
members.inviteLinkWarn: Issuing a new link stops the previous one from working.
members.groupUnassignConfirm: Remove the role granted to {{group}}? Everyone in that group loses what it confers.
members.passwordLinkNote: Hand this to the member yourself; it is not emailed.
members.resetFactorsConfirm: This clears {{name}}'s second factors. They will set one up again the next time they sign in.
members.resetFactorsSelf: Remove your own factors from your account settings, where the factor is asked for its code.

commentsPanel.readOnlyReason: Commenting is off for you on this page.

adminWebhooks.title: Webhooks
adminWebhooks.body: Send a signed event notification to an external URL when things happen. The signing secret is shown once.
adminWebhooks.secretOnce: Copy the signing secret now. It is shown only once.
adminWebhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete the endpoint {{url}}? Its signing secret is gone with it.

export.tenantHint: Download every space and page you can view as a Markdown ZIP (images included). Large workspaces can take a moment.
export.tooLarge: The export exceeds the size limit. Try exporting spaces individually.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Upload an export from Obsidian, Notion, Confluence, or this product. The archive is recognised from its own contents.
import.publishHint: On by default. Turn it off to bring everything in as drafts, visible only to people who can edit this space.
import.publicSpaceNote: This space is public, so imported pages can be read from outside the workspace as soon as they arrive.
import.resumable: This import runs on the server. You can leave this page and come back to this link.
import.failed: The import did not finish. Nothing was left half-imported.
import.busy: An import is already running for this space. Wait for it to finish, then reload this page.
import.tooLarge: The archive exceeds the size limit.
import.forbidden: You don't have permission to import into this space.
import.invalid: That file isn't a valid {{product}} export ZIP.
import.draftNotice: Everything came in as a draft. Until you publish a page, readers see it as empty.
import.publishedNotice_one: {{count}} page was published as it arrived.
import.publishedNotice_other: {{count}} pages were published as they arrived.

degraded.embedSizeDropped: embed display size or caption dropped
degraded.noteEmbedBecameLink: a note embedded in another note became a link
degraded.blockRefDropped: link to a single block, pointing at the page instead
degraded.headingAnchorDropped: link to a heading, pointing at the page instead
degraded.dataviewKeptAsSource: Dataview query kept as its source text
degraded.obsidianCommentKept: Obsidian comment (%%…%%) kept as ordinary text
degraded.inlineDataviewKept: inline Dataview expression kept as text
degraded.blockIdLeft: block identifier (^id) left in the text
degraded.excalidrawCompressed: Excalidraw drawing stored compressed, kept as its source
degraded.excalidrawUnreadable: Excalidraw drawing could not be read, kept as its source
degraded.notionDatabaseFlattened: database became a page with a table
degraded.confluenceMacroNoEquivalent: Confluence macro with no equivalent here
degraded.emojiReplacedByName: emoji image replaced by its name
degraded.linkOutsideExport: link to a page the export does not contain
degraded.attachmentLinkMissing: link to an attached file the archive does not carry
degraded.sourcePageLinkKept: link to a page in the export, left as written

degradedDetail.embedSizeDropped: the note wrote {{target}}|{{label}}; the picture came across, the sizing did not
degradedDetail.blockRefDropped: {{target}}{{anchor}}. A block reference has no equivalent here.
degradedDetail.dataviewKeptAsSource: {{count}} block(s). The query is preserved and shows as a code block.
degradedDetail.blockIdLeft: {{count}} paragraph(s). Nothing here refers to it.
degradedDetail.notionDatabaseFlattened: {{rows}} row(s). Notion views, filters and sorts have no equivalent here.
degradedDetail.confluenceStorageFormat: {{name}}. The text inside it was kept.
degradedDetail.mergedCellsFlattened: tables here have no merged cells
degradedDetail.emojiReplacedByName: {{name}}. The picture lived in the old installation.
degradedDetail.sourcePageLinkKept: {{target}}. This link shape is not resolved to a page yet.
degradedDetail.docmostIconDropped: {{icon}}. Pages here do not carry an icon.

import.degradedHint: Each of these is named with the page it was on, so you can decide what to redo by hand.
import.deadLinks_one: {{count}} link pointed outside the archive and was left as it was.
import.deadLinks_other: {{count}} links pointed outside the archive and were left as they were.
import.lossyTitles: Titles came from the folder and file names: the archive carried no title list of its own.

onboarding.changedBalancedModes: Kept Live, Reading and WYSIWYG (Source is in Settings)
onboarding.bannerText: Tailor the editor to how you write.

onboarding.atomHint: Tip: reference cards (embedded content, page embeds, child page lists) select as one unit, and Ctrl+Enter changes what they point at. Layouts and callouts open for editing when you click into them; everything else you just type into.

watches.empty: You are not watching anything yet

adminAudit.title: Audit log
adminAudit.body: The workspace's tamper-evident activity ledger (hash-chained, append-only). Admin actions, membership and access changes.
adminAudit.loadedAll: You have reached the beginning of the audit log.
adminAudit.lockedTitle: Audit log is a Team feature
adminAudit.lockedBody: Your entries are being retained. Upgrade to view, verify, and export the ledger.

adminRoles.title: Roles
adminRoles.lastCap: A role keeps at least one capability.
adminRoles.conflict: Name in use, or the role still has assignments. Unassign first.
adminRoles.notEntitled: Custom roles are a Team feature.
adminRoles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role "{{name}}"? Its assignments are removed with it. This cannot be undone.
adminRoles.tenantAssignBody: A workspace role (like creating spaces) is an attribute of a member, so it is granted here. Roles for a SPACE are granted in that space's Members tab.
adminRoles.memberDefaultsBody: What every member of this workspace can do, whatever role they hold.
adminRoles.groupAssignBody: Assign a workspace role to an IdP group. Everyone in the group gets it, and loses it when they leave the group.
adminRoles.scopeQuestion: Which kind of role is this?

deleteMode.both: Trash and permanent delete side by side

transparency.title: Vendor access
transparency.body: Emergency (break-glass) accesses to this workspace by the service operator (vendor), disclosed with a per-workspace chain you can verify for tampering.

accountApiKeys.title: API keys
accountApiKeys.body: Keys act with your own permissions, so a key can never do more than you can. The plaintext is shown once, when you create it.
accountApiKeys.restricted: This workspace lets only administrators create API keys. Any key you already hold still works, and you can revoke it here.

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.body: Refused publishes, rate-capped guests, and anonymous or share-link activity in this space. Mark an item once you have looked at it.
moderation.denied: You do not moderate this space.
moderation.empty: Nothing has been flagged in this space.

linkDialog.invalidUrl: Enter an http(s) or mailto URL, or a relative path.

adminScim.title: Automatic provisioning (SCIM)
adminScim.body: Let your identity provider create, update and deactivate members automatically. Give it the endpoint below and a token you mint here.
adminScim.revokeBody: Provisioning through “{{name}}” stops immediately, and your identity provider will need a new token.
adminScim.lockedTitle: Automatic provisioning is a Team feature
adminScim.lockedBody: Upgrade to let your identity provider create and deactivate members automatically.

adminDomains.releaseOperator: This address was registered by an operator and is the deployment’s own entrance. Remove it with the local-admin command, not from here.
adminDomains.title: Custom domains
adminDomains.body: Serve your workspace on your own hostname. Add the domain, publish the DNS record we show you, then verify.
adminDomains.dnsHint: Publish this DNS record, then verify:
adminDomains.passkeyBody: A passkey only works on the host it was created for, so {{count}} member(s) will have to enrol again after this domain takes over. Continue?
adminDomains.passkeyRetry: Passkeys would be lost. Confirm on the dialog to continue.
adminDomains.stanceBlocked: This workspace accepts passkeys only, so moving hosts would lock everyone out. Allow another second factor first, then verify.
adminDomains.releaseBody: {{domain}} stops resolving immediately, and adding it back means proving ownership again.
adminDomains.lockedTitle: Custom domains are a paid feature
adminDomains.lockedBody: Upgrade to serve your workspace on your own hostname.
adminDomains.notVerified: We could not find that TXT record yet. If you published it a moment ago, DNS can take a few minutes to spread. Wait, then verify again.
